content.short: GMGN is a multi-chain memecoin trading terminal combining fast swaps, launch sniping, copy trading, and smart money tracking.
content.description: GMGN is a multi-chain trading terminal aimed at memecoin markets, running since 2023 across Solana, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Base, Monad, and TRON. It pulls the workflow into one place: swaps and launch sniping, wallet level smart money tracking to see what profitable addresses are accumulating, automated copy trading that runs continuously, and contract safety checks before entering a position. The same account is reachable from the web app, mobile, a Telegram bot, and a command line client, and GMGN has no token of its own.
